en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Do you recognise your Imam<sup>asws</sup>?’ I said, ‘Yes, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, before I came out from Al-Kufa’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then it is sufficient for you’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abdallah ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from aban from abu Basir saying that Imam abu Ja’far‘far (a.s.) said to him the following.
“Have you found out who your Imam is?” I said, “Yes, I swear by Allah, I did so before I left Kufa.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Then it is sufficient for you.”
